wins.text: Q4 net sales grew 11% YoY to $2.03B, marking the second consecutive quarter of double-digit growth despite a sluggish industrial economy
Full-year 2025 record annual sales of $8.2B, up ~9% vs. 2024, with net income of $1.26B, up 9.4% YoY
Q4 net income increased 12.2% YoY to $294.1M; SG&A as % of sales improved to 25.4% from 25.9% a year ago, demonstrating cost discipline
Active $50,000-plus customer sites rose 14% YoY and now account for just over half of revenues; $10,000-plus sites up ~8% to over 11,700
Operating cash flow of ~$370M representing 125% of net income; ROIC increased 90 bps YoY to ~31%; returned just over $1B in dividends (~80% of net income)

risks.text: Gross margin declined 50 bps in Q4 2025 vs. prior year due to timing of supplier rebates (negative true-up vs. positive last year) and inventory-related cost flows; fastener expansion project anniversaries after Q1 2026, removing a key gross margin tailwind

Tariff and price/cost management remains challenging in non-fastener categories where branded supplier visibility is limited; Q4 net price/cost impact was -10 bps, and management acknowledged being 'wrong' on prior pricing forecasts

Broader industrial macro remains weak — PMI averaged low 48s in Q4, industrial production was close to flat YoY, and management explicitly said they are not seeing the green shoots of improvement in their own numbers
CapEx expected to increase to ~3.5% of net sales in 2026 from 2.8% in 2025, reflecting a meaningful step-up in investment spending that will pressure free cash flow

December ADS was pressured by extended customer shutdowns around the holidays (customers shut down doubled YoY over New Year's week), creating sequential softness and uncertainty around near-term demand normalization

guidance_items.detail: Management expressed expectation of double-digit net sales growth in 2026, supported by FMI technology and digital solutions momentum — framed as directional outlook, not formal guidance
Modest annual gross margin contraction expected in 2026 as fastener expansion project anniversaries after Q1; management believes SG&A efficiencies will offset at the operating margin level
CapEx guided to ~3.5% of net sales in 2026, up from 2.8% in 2025, with investments in hub capacity, FMI devices, and IT enhancements

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Incremental margin expectations for 2026 (high-20s framework) and the mechanics of incentive comp lapping
Deceleration in e-business growth as a percentage of total sales and whether it will reaccelerate
Specific quantification of the holiday shutdown impact on December ADS and January normalization trajectory
